notes.title: MAJOR UPDATE LIVE
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31042720/3e54ed2ee11b8eefbf19dc41c3f89bb894c796bb.png[/img]
This is the first public update to GTH in a long time and a lot has changed thanks to player feedback. The game has been split into a series of missions to allow for a more challenging experience. Missions are also ranked on a public leader board to compete with other players. Obviously many other changes were implemented to allow the new game mode and I hope everyone enjoys this major overhaul of the game.

notes.title: GIFT TO HUMANITY: Update Live
notes.content:
The latest update is now live with the following changes:

Phase-Shift: The game just got a lot faster with phase-shift, allowing you to teleport of all over the place.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33658359/d686d1473ab0410a30655d14cf5bf0b715f7d404.png[/img]

Vital Areas: Head shots now deal additional damage to enemies.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33658359/40b92dbef1ac9a89e4ca3025ee378f71be8ba194.png[/img]

AI Update: AI will now behave more realistically and patrol the map while out of combat.

notes.title: MAJOR UPDATE: Third Person | Campaign | AI | Co-op | Arena
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33658359/e9591ca3122a702451bd51be2d3c04ad911fcbba.png[/img]

On player demand Gift To Humanity was reworked and converted from a top-down to third-person shooter putting you right in the action.

Campaign: Chapter 2 has been finalized and is now fully playable which includes new enemies, skills, gear and some more pieces of the puzzle.

AI Update: Converting the game from top-down to third-person required an complete rework of AI.

Co-op: On request co-op has been added and is now available for public beta testing. You can now enjoy the campaign with your friends.

Arena: With co-op making its way into the game I decided to add arena as a bonus. Here you can challenge your friends to a game of wits and skills.

I hope you enjoy the changes, and I'm looking forward to your feedback on how I can improve.

Regards
Ultima Games

notes.title: UPDATE 1.0.3.8
notes.content:
Thanks to everyone who gave me feedback, its much appreciated. Based on your feedback I've made the following changes, with more to come.

-Shield Attribute Added.
-Extreme difficulty now available.
-Balance changes to all difficulties.
-Bug Fixes.

notes.title: UPDATE 1.0.3.7
notes.content:
Update 1.0.3.7 is now available for public beta.

- Chapter 2 is now available, with new enemies, gear and exo-modules.
- Survival V2: New waves added with customizable turrets for support.
- Bug fixes.
- General balancing changes.
- Gear balancing changes.

Hope you enjoy, and please report all bugs.

Happy Gaming
